entries.title: Psalms 7:1
segments: ¶<Shiggaion of David; a song which he made to the Lord, about the words of Cush the Benjamite.> O Lord my God, I put my faith in you; take me out of the hands of him who is cruel to me, and make me free;

entries.title: Psalms 7:2
segments: So that he may not come rushing on my soul like a lion, wounding it, while there is no one to be my saviour.

entries.title: Psalms 7:3
segments: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if my hands have done any wrong;

entries.title: Psalms 7:4
segments: If I have given back evil to him who did evil to me, or have taken anything from him who was against me without cause;

entries.title: Psalms 7:5
segments: Let my hater go after my soul and take it; let my life be crushed to the earth, and my honour into the dust. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 7:6
segments: Come up, Lord, in your wrath; be lifted up against my haters; be awake, my God, give orders for the judging.

entries.title: Psalms 7:7
segments: The meeting of the nations will be round you; take your seat, then, over them, on high.

entries.title: Psalms 7:8
segments: The Lord will be judge of the peoples; give a decision for me, O Lord, because of my righteousness, and let my virtue have its reward.

entries.title: Psalms 7:9
segments: O let the evil of the evil-doer come to an end, but give strength to the upright: for men's minds and hearts are tested by the God of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 7:10
segments: ¶God, who is the saviour of the upright in heart, is my breastplate.

entries.title: Psalms 7:11
segments: God is the judge of the upright, and is angry with the evil-doers every day.

entries.title: Psalms 7:12
segments: If a man is not turned from his evil, he will make his sword sharp; his bow is bent and ready.

entries.title: Psalms 7:13
segments: He has made ready for him the instruments of death; he makes his arrows flames of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 7:14
segments: That man is a worker of evil; the seed of wrongdoing has given birth to deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 7:15
segments: He has made a hole deep in the earth, and is falling into the hole which he has made

entries.title: Psalms 7:16
segments: His wrongdoing will come back to him, and his violent behaviour will come down on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 7:17
segments: I will give praise to the Lord for his righteousness; I will make a song to the name of the Lord Most High.
